payload.name: Citadel Buster
payload.description: The boss and adds join together with an orange tether and turn to face the same direction, then start charging a massive attack that hits half the arena. When the adds form a line after Electrochemical Transfer, go near the center of the arena in advance, then watch where they face to move behind to the safe half. It's important to do this quickly as halfway through the cast, the ground under the adds will turn into a brown line. Touching it will deal moderate damage, inflict a 60s vuln stack, and do massive knockback towards the direction you came from, so you can no longer cross once this line appears. If you still try to cross or are crossing when it appears, you will likely die to the charged attack unless you are healed up in time. This attack also inflicts 20s of uncleansable Damage Down.

payload.name: Primordial Aether
payload.description: Tethers to one of the green projections of Warring Triad primals outside the arena, absorbing it and mimicking its abilities temporarily. Each can only be absorbed once, after which its projection disappears. The primal's name will be mentioned in an NPC announcement. Sephirot: Targets all players with green AoE markers. When they go off (Ratzon), they place an expanding green orb under each player. Touching these orbs will repeatedly deal light damage and inflict a 60s vuln stack. Try to place these markers near the edge of the arena and not too far apart, to maximize the safe area you have left once the orbs expand. The boss uses Citadel Buster twice during this. Sophia: Targets a random player with a shrinking black ring marker and another with a similar white ring. These players must stay stacked as the rings finish shrinking to cancel out their effects. Doing so successfully will show black text stating "Equilibrium between sin and punishment maintained.". Otherwise, the black ring inflicts 20s of Reduced Immunity (Dischordant Cleansing) and the white ring inflicts 20s of Bleeding. This occurs twice, the second time targeting the other two players who have not yet been marked. The boss uses Ceruleum Vent followed by Citadel Buster twice during this. Zurvan: Afflicts two players with File:InfiniteFireZurvan.png Infinite Fire and two with File:InfiniteIceZurvan.png Infinite Ice. A fire meteor (Southern Star) and an ice meteor (Northern Star) then start slowly descending on opposite sides of the arena. All players should stand under the meteor that matches their debuff (fire with fire, ice with ice). Doing so cleanses the debuff, with black text stating "The seal is broken! Infinity fades...". Failing to soak the correct meteor instead inflicts 12s of File:InfiniteAnguishZurvan.png Infinite Anguish. If a meteor is not correctly soaked by at least one player, it will explode, dealing moderate raidwide damage and inflicting a 60s vuln stack. The boss uses Ceruleum Vent during this.

payload.name: Fog Plume
payload.description: Star-shaped AoE placed towards the south of the arena. There is an initial circular AoE at the landing point (though this may not be obvious from the telegraph). Then, four line AoEs will originate from it. Getting hit by any of these AoEs inflicts a vulnerability up Vulnerability Up stack and traps you in a block of ice called Mist for up to 10s. While trapped, you suffer from deep freeze Deep Freeze damage over time. The Mist is extremely brittle and can be attacked by others to free its trapped player. Later on in the fight, the boss will instead place 2 of these star-shaped AoEs in a randomly rotated but fixed pattern.

payload.name: Landslip
payload.description: The arena is covered in four "conveyor belt" line markers, and a few Silt Golem adds will spawn on the outside of the arena. When the cast completes, all players will be pushed in the direction of the arrows a distance roughly equivalent to half the arena. As players are being pushed, the Silt Golems will cast Rockslide, damaging in a line ahead of them and inflicting Vulnerability Up. Players should do their best to be pushed into a safe area, as there's little time to avoid Rockslide after being pushed.
